ContractorProfile.title: ContractorProfile
ContractorProfile.description: Represents a service contractor's business profile and default settings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ContractorProfile entity. (Primary Key)

businessName.description: The official name of the contractor's business.

licenseNumber.description: The contractor's business license number, if applicable.

logoUrl.description: URL to the contractor's business logo, used for branding quotes.

defaultTaxRate.description: The default tax rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.08 for 8%) applied to new quotes.

defaultLaborRate.description: The default hourly labor rate used for calculations in new quotes.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the contractor profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the contractor profile was last updated.

Client.title: Client
Client.description: Stores information about a client associated with a contractor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Client entity. (Primary Key)

contractorId.description: Reference to the ContractorProfile that owns this client. (Relationship: ContractorProfile 1:N Client)

addressLine1.description: The first line of the client's street address.

addressLine2.description: The second line of the client's street address (e.g., apartment, suite).

city.description: The city of the client's address.

state.description: The state or province of the client's address.

zipCode.description: The postal code of the client's address.

notes.description: Any additional notes or specific instructions for the client.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the client record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the client record was last updated.

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: Represents a professional client quote generated by a contractor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Quote entity. (Primary Key)

contractorId.description: Reference to the ContractorProfile that created this quote. (Relationship: ContractorProfile 1:N Quote)

clientId.description: Reference to the Client for whom this quote was prepared. (Relationship: Client 1:N Quote)

quoteNumber.description: A unique, human-readable identifier for the quote (e.g., Q2023-001).

title.description: A concise title or summary for the quote (e.g., 'Painting Project for Mr. Smith').

description.description: A detailed overall description of the work scope, potentially AI-generated for clarity.

issueDate.description: The date and time the quote was issued.

expirationDate.description: The date and time after which the quote is no longer valid.

status.description: The current status of the quote (e.g., 'Draft', 'Sent', 'Viewed', 'Accepted', 'Rejected', 'Archived').

subtotalAmount.description: The sum of all quote item total prices before discounts and taxes.

discountAmount.description: The total monetary discount applied to the quote.

taxRateApplied.description: The tax rate (as a decimal) applied to this specific quote at the time of creation/update.

taxAmount.description: The calculated total tax amount for the quote.

totalAmount.description: The final total amount of the quote, including discounts and taxes.

contractorNotes.description: Internal notes for the contractor regarding this quote (not visible to client).

clientFacingNotes.description: Notes displayed to the client on the quote document.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the quote was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the quote was last updated.

QuoteItem.title: QuoteItem
QuoteItem.description: Represents a single line item or service detail within a client quote.

id.description: Unique identifier for the QuoteItem entity. (Primary Key)

quoteId.description: Reference to the Quote this item belongs to. (Relationship: Quote 1:N QuoteItem)

description.description: A detailed description of the work, material, or service provided for this item.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item (e.g., hours, square feet, units).

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the item.

totalPrice.description: The calculated total price for this item (quantity * unitPrice).

notes.description: Specific notes or instructions related to this quote item.

paintColor.description: Specific paint color used, if applicable to a painting job item.

areaSqFt.description: The area in square feet relevant to this item, typically for painting, flooring, or other area-based services.

numberOfCoats.description: The number of paint coats applied, if applicable to a painting job item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the quote item was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the quote item was last updated.

definition.description: Stores the business profile and default settings for a service contractor. The document ID (`contractorId`) corresponds directly to the Firebase Authentication UID of the contractor, establishing direct ownership.

params.name: contractorId
params.description: The Firebase Authentication User ID (UID) of the contractor who owns this profile.

definition.description: Contains client information associated with a specific contractor. Includes denormalized 'contractorId' for authorization independence, ensuring rules can directly verify ownership.

params.name: contractorId
params.description: The Firebase Authentication User ID (UID) of the contractor who owns this client record.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The unique identifier for the client.

definition.description: Stores professional quotes generated by a contractor for a client. Includes denormalized 'contractorId' for authorization independence, allowing direct ownership verification in security rules.

params.name: contractorId
params.description: The Firebase Authentication User ID (UID) of the contractor who created this quote.

params.description: The unique identifier for the quote.

definition.description: Represents a single line item within a specific quote. Crucially, this document MUST include a denormalized 'contractorId' field to enable authorization independence, allowing security rules to verify ownership without requiring a 'get()' call to the parent quote or contractor profile.

params.name: contractorId
params.description: The Firebase Authentication User ID (UID) of the contractor who owns the parent quote.

params.name: quoteId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent quote.

params.name: quoteItemId
params.description: The unique identifier for the quote item.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore data structure adheres strictly to the core design principles, prioritizing Authorization Independence and Structural Segregation to ensure robust, scalable, and debuggable security rules. All data entities are organized hierarchically under a top-level `contractorProfiles` collection, where each document's ID directly corresponds to the authenticated user's Firebase UID (`request.auth.uid`). This establishes clear, path-based ownership for all contractor-specific data.

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):**
This design achieves authorization independence by denormalizing the `contractorId` into all relevant subcollection documents. 
- The `Client` entity's schema already includes `contractorId`, aligning it with its parent `contractorProfile` and the `/contractorProfiles/{contractorId}/clients/{clientId}` path. This means a rule for clients only needs to check `request.auth.uid == resource.data.contractorId` (or `contractorId` from the path), without a `get()` operation to the parent `contractorProfile`.
- Similarly, the `Quote` entity's schema already includes `contractorId`, allowing its security rules (`/contractorProfiles/{contractorId}/quotes/{quoteId}`) to verify ownership directly via `request.auth.uid == resource.data.contractorId`.
- For `QuoteItem` entities, which are nested under a `Quote`, the critical step is to include a denormalized `contractorId` field within each `QuoteItem` document. This allows security rules for `/contractorProfiles/{contractorId}/quotes/{quoteId}/quoteItems/{quoteItemId}` to check `request.auth.uid == resource.data.contractorId` without needing to perform a `get()` call to its parent `quote` or grandparent `contractorProfile` to ascertain ownership. This is fundamental for atomic operations and rule performance.

**Querying for Authorization Purposes (QAPs):**
This structure inherently supports QAPs (rules are not filters) by ensuring that all documents within a given subcollection path implicitly belong to the `contractorId` specified in that path. 
- For `contractorProfiles/{contractorId}`, a contractor will query their own profile by `get('/contractorProfiles/' + request.auth.uid)`, which is trivially secure.
- For `clients`, `quotes`, and `quoteItems`, `list` operations will always occur within the context of a specific contractor's data, e.g., `/contractorProfiles/{contractorId}/clients`. Security rules will enforce that `contractorId` in the path matches `request.auth.uid`, and additionally, for denormalized documents, that `resource.data.contractorId` matches `request.auth.uid`. Any client-side query attempting to fetch data from a different `contractorId` would be denied. This design guarantees that `list` queries will only return data the user is authorized to see, eliminating the need for `get()` calls in rules to validate parent ownership for `list` operations.
